pr.title: Fix overseer max_turns exhaustion and add respawn visibility
pr.description:
The overseer agent crashes mid-pipeline because max_turns=500 is too low for its
continuous monitoring loop. Adds configurable overseer_max_turns (default 2000) and
broadcasts an OVERSEER_ALERT with diagnostics when the overseer is respawned.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: test_overseer_spawn.py covers config defaults/bounds, max_turns passthrough, respawn broadcast, and graceful fallbacks
- Automated: test_phase_scoped_overseer.py covers phase-scoped respawn behavior with new parameter
- Manual: Run a short-flow pipeline with overseer enabled and verify the overseer survives a full implement phase without max_turns exhaustion
pr.manual_steps:
Pre-merge: None required
Post-merge: Monitor next few overseer-enabled pipelines for absence of mid-phase restarts
